system.description: Ancient and noble elves with strong ties to arcane magic. Scholars, artisans, and mages who value knowledge, magical prowess, and cultural refinement.
traits: Fey Ancestry: Advantage on saves against being charmed or magically put to sleep.
Arcane Training: You can cast one cantrip of your choice from any spell list.
Trance: You meditate for 4 hours instead of sleeping for 8 hours.
Keen Mind: You always know which way is north and can accurately recall anything you've seen or heard within the past month.
